name: HelloFresh SE
business_summary: HelloFresh SE, together with its subsidiaries, operates as meal kit provider in the United States, Canada, and internationally. The company provides meal kits; add-on products including soups, desserts, bakery products, salads, and surcharge products; ready-to-eat meals; and other products. It operates under the HelloFresh, Chefs Plate, Good Chop, Pets Table, EveryPlate, Factor, Green Chef, and YouFoodz brand names. HelloFresh SE was founded in 2011 and is headquartered in Berlin, Germany.
